theorem exists_centres_level {R c : ℕ} (γ : Module.End ℤ_[l] X) {u : ℤ_[l]} (hX : GenBy l R X) (hu : IsLevel l u c) (j : ℕ) :
    ∃ s : Fin R → ℤ_[l], ∀ e : ℕ, twLen γ u e j ≤ ∑ i, (((j + c : ℕ) : ℕ∞) + vl l (s i - e)) := by
  obtain ⟨S, hS⟩ := lift l X R (γ ^ l ^ j) hX
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := detBound l u c hu j R S
  refine ⟨s, fun e => ?_⟩
  have hpow : (u ^ e • γ) ^ l ^ j = (u ^ l ^ j) ^ e • γ ^ l ^ j := by
    rw [smul_pow, ← pow_mul, ← pow_mul, mul_comm]
  show cokLen ((u ^ e • γ) ^ l ^ j - 1) ≤ _
  rw [hpow]
  exact (hS _).trans (hs e)

  haveI : IsAlgClosed Ω := IsAlgClosure.isAlgClosed L₀
  haveI : FiniteDimensional L₀ L₁ := Module.Finite.of_restrictScalars_finite ℚ L₀ L₁
  let j : L₁ →ₐ[L₀] Ω := IsAlgClosed.lift
  letI : Algebra L₁ Ω := j.toRingHom.toAlgebra
  haveI : IsScalarTower L₀ L₁ Ω := IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun x => (j.commutes x).symm

theorem UpperTheory.V.Tower.qzSep :
    ∀ (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (M : Type) [AddCommGroup M] [Module ℤ_[l] M] (m : M), m ≠ 0 → ∃ f : M →ₗ[ℤ_[l]] QZ l, f m ≠ 0 := by
  intro l _ M _ _ m hm
  obtain ⟨x, hx0, hx⟩ := exists_qz_ne_zero_annihilators_of_ne_zero l M m hm
  set K := LinearMap.ker (LinearMap.toSpanSingleton ℤ_[l] M m) with hK
  have hle : K ≤ LinearMap.ker (LinearMap.toSpanSingleton ℤ_[l] (QZ l) x) := by
    intro a ha
    rw [LinearMap.mem_ker, LinearMap.toSpanSingleton_apply] at ha ⊢
    exact hx a ha

  let g := K.liftQ (LinearMap.toSpanSingleton ℤ_[l] (QZ l) x) hle
  have hf : Function.Injective f := LinearMap.ker_eq_bot.mp (K.ker_liftQ_eq_bot _ _ le_rfl)
  haveI := UpperTheory.V.PropA.qzInj l
  obtain ⟨h, hh⟩ := Module.Injective.out f hf g
  refine ⟨h, ?_⟩
  have h1 := hh (K.mkQ 1)
  simp only [f, g, Submodule.mkQ_apply, Submodule.liftQ_apply, LinearMap.toSpanSingleton_apply,
    one_smul] at h1

private theorem simple_dual (l : ℕ) [hl : Fact l.Prime]
    (N : Type) [AddCommGroup N] [Module ℤ_[l] N] [hN : IsSimpleModule ℤ_[l] N] :
    IsSimpleModule ℤ_[l] (N →ₗ[ℤ_[l]] QZ l) := by
  haveI : Nontrivial N := IsSimpleModule.nontrivial ℤ_[l] N
  have hnu : (l : ℤ_[l]) ∈ nonunits ℤ_[l] :=
    (IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal _).mp
      (by rw [PadicInt.maximalIdeal_eq_span_p]; exact Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self _)
  have hspan : ∀ s : N, s ≠ 0 → ∀ x : N, ∃ c : ℤ_[l], c • s = x := by
    intro s hs x
    have htop : Submodule.span ℤ_[l] {s} = ⊤ :=
      (IsSimpleOrder.eq_bot_or_eq_top _).resolve_left
        (by simpa [Submodule.span_singleton_eq_bot] using hs)
    exact Submodule.mem_span_singleton.mp (htop ▸ Submodule.mem_top)
  have hkill : ∀ s : N, (l : ℤ_[l]) • s = 0 := by
    intro s
    by_contra h
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hspan _ h s
    have hu : IsUnit (1 - c * (l : ℤ_[l])) :=
      IsLocalRing.isUnit_one_sub_self_of_mem_nonunits _ (mul_mem_nonunits_right hnu)
    have h0 : (1 - c * (l : ℤ_[l])) • s = 0 := by
      rw [sub_smul, one_smul, mul_smul, hc, sub_self]
    have hs0 : s = 0 := (hu.smul_eq_zero).mp h0
    exact h (by rw [hs0, smul_zero])
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := exists_ne (0 : N)
  obtain ⟨φ0, hφ0⟩ := qzSep l N s hs
  obtain ⟨ι, hιinj, hιrange, hιsmul⟩ := zmodToQZ l 1
  haveI : Fact (Nat.Prime (l ^ 1)) := ⟨by rw [pow_one]; exact hl.out⟩
  have hrange : ∀ φ : N →ₗ[ℤ_[l]] QZ l, ∃ a, ι a = φ s := by
    intro φ
    refine (hιrange (φ s)).mpr ?_
    rw [pow_one, ← LinearMap.map_smul_of_tower, hkill, map_zero]
  have key : ∀ φ ψ : N →ₗ[ℤ_[l]] QZ l, φ ≠ 0 → ∃ z : ℤ_[l], ψ = z • φ := by
    intro φ ψ hφ
    have hφs : φ s ≠ 0 := by
      intro h
      apply hφ
      ext x
      obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := hspan s hs x
      simp [h]
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hrange φ
    obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := hrange ψ
    have ha0 : a ≠ 0 := by
      rintro rfl
      exact hφs (by rw [← ha, map_zero])
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := ZMod.natCast_zmod_surjective (b * a⁻¹)
    have hb' : b = PadicInt.toZModPow 1 (k : ℤ_[l]) * a := by
      rw [map_natCast, hk, inv_mul_cancel_right₀ ha0]
    refine ⟨(k : ℤ_[l]), ?_⟩
    ext x
    obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := hspan s hs x
    rw [map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply, map_smul, ← hb, ← ha, hb', hιsmul, smul_comm]
  haveI : Nontrivial (N →ₗ[ℤ_[l]] QZ l) := ⟨⟨φ0, 0, fun h => hφ0 (by rw [h]; rfl)⟩⟩
  refine { eq_bot_or_eq_top := fun P => ?_ }
  by_cases h : P = ⊥
  · exact Or.inl h
  · right
    obtain ⟨φ, hφP, hφ0'⟩ := Submodule.exists_mem_ne_zero_of_ne_bot h
    rw [eq_top_iff]
    intro ψ _
    obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := key φ ψ hφ0'
    exact P.smul_mem z hφP

private theorem le_dual (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (N : Type) [AddCommGroup N] [Module ℤ_[l] N] :
    Module.length ℤ_[l] N ≤ Module.length ℤ_[l] (N →ₗ[ℤ_[l]] QZ l) := by
  rw [← WithBot.coe_le_coe, Module.coe_length, Module.coe_length, ← Order.krullDim_orderDual]
  refine Order.krullDim_le_of_strictMono
    (fun p : (Submodule ℤ_[l] N)ᵒᵈ =>
      LinearMap.ker (LinearMap.lcomp ℤ_[l] (QZ l) (OrderDual.ofDual p).subtype)) ?_
  intro a b hab
  change OrderDual.ofDual b < OrderDual.ofDual a at hab
  obtain ⟨hle, m, hmp, hmq⟩ := SetLike.lt_iff_le_and_exists.mp hab
  refine lt_of_le_of_ne ?_ ?_
  · intro φ hφ
    rw [LinearMap.mem_ker] at hφ ⊢
    ext ⟨x, hx⟩
    have h := LinearMap.congr_fun hφ ⟨x, hle hx⟩
    simpa using h
  · intro heq
    have hm0 : (OrderDual.ofDual b).mkQ m ≠ 0 := by
      rwa [Ne, Submodule.mkQ_apply, Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero]
    obtain ⟨ψ, hψ⟩ := qzSep l _ _ hm0
    have hmem : ψ ∘ₗ (OrderDual.ofDual b).mkQ ∈
        LinearMap.ker (LinearMap.lcomp ℤ_[l] (QZ l) (OrderDual.ofDual b).subtype) := by
      rw [LinearMap.mem_ker]
      ext ⟨x, hx⟩
      simp [(Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero _).mpr hx]
    have hmem' := hmem
    simp only at heq
    rw [← heq, LinearMap.mem_ker] at hmem'
    exact hψ (by simpa using LinearMap.congr_fun hmem' ⟨m, hmp⟩)

theorem UpperTheory.V.Tower.lenDual :
    ∀ (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (M : Type) [AddCommGroup M] [Module ℤ_[l] M], Module.length ℤ_[l] (M →ₗ[ℤ_[l]] QZ l) = Module.length ℤ_[l] M := by
  intro l _ M _ _
  by_cases hM : IsFiniteLength ℤ_[l] M
  · induction hM with
    | @of_subsingleton M' _ _ _ =>
      haveI : Subsingleton (M' →ₗ[ℤ_[l]] QZ l) :=
        ⟨fun f g => LinearMap.ext fun x => by rw [Subsingleton.elim x 0, map_zero, map_zero]⟩
      simp [Module.length_eq_zero]
    | @of_simple_quotient M' _ _ N _ _ ih =>
      have hS := simple_dual l (M' ⧸ N)
      have e1 := Module.length_eq_add_of_exact N.subtype N.mkQ N.injective_subtype

theorem UpperTheory.V.Tower.dualKer :
    ∀ (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (M : Type) [AddCommGroup M] [Module ℤ_[l] M] (M' : Type) [AddCommGroup M'] [Module ℤ_[l] M'] (T : M →ₗ[ℤ_[l]] M'),
        LinearMap.range (LinearMap.lcomp ℤ_[l] (QZ l) T) = LinearMap.ker (LinearMap.lcomp ℤ_[l] (QZ l) (LinearMap.ker T).subtype) ∧
        ∀ p : Submodule ℤ_[l] M, Function.Surjective (LinearMap.lcomp ℤ_[l] (QZ l) p.subtype) := by
  intro l _ M _ _ M' _ _ T
  have hI := PropA.qzInj l
  refine ⟨?_, fun p g => ?_⟩
  · ext f
    rw [LinearMap.mem_range, LinearMap.mem_ker]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨g, rfl⟩
      ext ⟨x, hx⟩
      simp only [LinearMap.lcomp_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply, Submodule.subtype_apply,
        LinearMap.zero_apply]
      rw [LinearMap.mem_ker.mp hx, map_zero]
    · intro hf
      have hle : LinearMap.ker T ≤ LinearMap.ker f := by
        intro x hx
        have := LinearMap.congr_fun hf ⟨x, hx⟩
        simpa using this
      let g0 : LinearMap.range T →ₗ[ℤ_[l]] QZ l :=
        ((LinearMap.ker T).liftQ f hle).comp (LinearMap.quotKerEquivRange T).symm.toLinearMap
      obtain ⟨h, hh⟩ := hI.out (LinearMap.range T).subtype Subtype.val_injective g0
      refine ⟨h, ?_⟩
      ext x
      simp only [LinearMap.lcomp_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply]
      have := hh ⟨T x, LinearMap.mem_range_self T x⟩
      simp only [Submodule.subtype_apply] at this
      rw [this]
      simp [g0, LinearMap.quotKerEquivRange_symm_apply_image]
  · obtain ⟨h, hh⟩ := hI.out p.subtype Subtype.val_injective g
    refine ⟨h, ?_⟩
    ext x
    simpa using hh x

theorem UpperTheory.V.PropA.frob :
    ∀ (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (X : Type) [AddCommGroup X] [Module ℤ_[l] X] (g : Module.End ℤ_[l] X) (k : ℕ),
      InPow 1 ((g - 1) ^ l ^ k) ↔ InPow 1 (g ^ l ^ k - 1) := by
  intro l _ X _ _ g k
  have hpoly : (Polynomial.C (l : ℤ)) ∣
      ((Polynomial.X - 1) ^ l ^ k - (Polynomial.X ^ l ^ k - 1) : Polynomial ℤ) := by
    rw [Polynomial.C_dvd_iff_dvd_coeff]
    intro i
    have hmap : Polynomial.map (Int.castRingHom (ZMod l))
        ((Polynomial.X - 1) ^ l ^ k - (Polynomial.X ^ l ^ k - 1) : Polynomial ℤ) = 0 := by
      simp only [Polynomial.map_sub, Polynomial.map_pow, Polynomial.map_X, Polynomial.map_one]
      rw [sub_pow_char_pow, one_pow, sub_self]
    have hc := congrArg (fun P => Polynomial.coeff P i) hmap
    simp only [Polynomial.coeff_map, Polynomial.coeff_zero] at hc
    exact (ZMod.intCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd _ l).1 hc
  obtain ⟨Q, hQ⟩ := hpoly
  have key : (g - 1) ^ l ^ k - (g ^ l ^ k - 1) = (l : Module.End ℤ_[l] X) * Polynomial.aeval g Q := by
    have := congrArg (Polynomial.aeval g) hQ
    simpa using this
  have step : ∀ f f' : Module.End ℤ_[l] X, (∃ h : Module.End ℤ_[l] X, f - f' = (l : Module.End ℤ_[l] X) * h) →
      InPow 1 f' → InPow 1 f := by
    rintro f f' ⟨h, hh⟩ H x
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := H x
    refine ⟨y + h x, ?_⟩
    have hf : f = (l : Module.End ℤ_[l] X) * h + f' := eq_add_of_sub_eq hh
    rw [pow_one] at hy ⊢
    rw [hf, LinearMap.add_apply, Module.End.mul_apply, Module.End.natCast_apply, hy, smul_add,
      Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul ℤ_[l] l (h x), add_comm]
  constructor
  · exact step _ _ ⟨-Polynomial.aeval g Q, by rw [mul_neg, ← key, neg_sub]⟩
  · exact step _ _ ⟨Polynomial.aeval g Q, key⟩

theorem UpperTheory.V.PropA.powIn :
    ∀ (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (X : Type) [AddCommGroup X] [Module ℤ_[l] X] (w : Module.End ℤ_[l] X),
      (∀ k n : ℕ, InPow k (w - 1) → InPow k (w ^ n - 1)) ∧ (InPow 1 (w - 1) → InPow 2 (w ^ l - 1)) := by
  intro l _ X _ _ w
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · intro k n H x
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := H x
    refine ⟨(∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, w ^ i) y, ?_⟩
    rw [← geom_sum_mul, Module.End.mul_apply, hy, map_smul]
  · intro H x
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := H x
    obtain ⟨y', hy'⟩ := H y
    rw [pow_one] at hy hy'
    refine ⟨y + ∑ i ∈ Finset.range l, (∑ j ∈ Finset.range i, w ^ j) y', ?_⟩
    have hw : ∀ i, (w ^ i) y = y + (l : ℤ_[l]) • (∑ j ∈ Finset.range i, w ^ j) y' := by
      intro i
      have h0 : (w ^ i - 1) y = (∑ j ∈ Finset.range i, w ^ j) ((w - 1) y) := by
        rw [← Module.End.mul_apply, geom_sum_mul]
      rw [hy', map_smul] at h0
      rw [← h0, LinearMap.sub_apply, Module.End.one_apply, add_sub_cancel]
    rw [← geom_sum_mul, Module.End.mul_apply, hy, map_smul, LinearMap.sum_apply]
    simp_rw [hw]
    rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_range, ← Finset.smul_sum,
      ← Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul ℤ_[l], ← smul_add, pow_two, mul_smul]

theorem UpperTheory.V.PropA.detFactor :
    ∀ (K : Type) [Field K] [IsAlgClosed K] (n : ℕ) (S : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) K),
      ∃ z : Fin n → K, ∀ c : K, (c • S - 1).det = ∏ i, (c * z i - 1) := by
  intro K _ _ n S
  classical
  set p := S.charpoly with hp

theorem UpperTheory.V.Tower.cycRange :
    ∀ (L Ω : Type) [Field L] [NumberField L] [Field Ω] [Algebra L Ω] [IsAlgClosure L Ω] (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime], HasMuQ l L → (cycZ L Ω l).range = KStar.TotallyRealRoots.princ l (cZero l L) := by
  intro L Ω _ _ _ _ _ l _ hq
  have hmu := muQ L Ω l
  haveI : IsAlgClosed Ω := IsAlgClosure.isAlgClosed L
  haveI : CharZero Ω := charZero_of_injective_algebraMap (algebraMap L Ω).injective
  haveI : IsGalois L Ω := inferInstance
  haveI : NeZero (l : Ω) := ⟨by exact_mod_cast (Fact.out : l.Prime).ne_zero⟩
  haveI : NeZero l := ⟨(Fact.out : l.Prime).ne_zero⟩
  have hinj := (algebraMap L Ω).injective
  have key : ∀ (σ : G L Ω) (n : ℕ) (t : Ω), t ^ l ^ n = 1 →
      σ t = t ^ ((cycZ L Ω l σ : ℤ_[l]).toZModPow n).val := by
    intro σ n t ht
    exact cyclotomicCharacter.spec (L := Ω) l (MulSemiringAction.toRingAut (G L Ω) Ω σ) t ht
  have hmem : ∀ (a : ℕ) (u : ℤ_[l]ˣ), u ∈ KStar.TotallyRealRoots.princ l a ↔ (u : ℤ_[l]).toZModPow a = 1 := by
    intro a u
    simp [KStar.TotallyRealRoots.princ, KStar.TotallyRealRoots.redPow, MonoidHom.mem_ker, Units.ext_iff]
  have hone : ∀ (n : ℕ) (t : Ω), IsPrimitiveRoot t (l ^ n) → t ^ ((1 : ZMod (l ^ n)).val) = t := by
    intro n t ht
    rw [ZMod.val_one_eq_one_mod, ht.eq_orderOf, pow_mod_orderOf, pow_one]

private theorem lu_key (L Ω : Type) [Field L] [NumberField L] [Field Ω] [Algebra L Ω] [IsAlgClosure L Ω] (l : ℕ)
    [Fact l.Prime] (hmu : HasMuQ l L) (n : ℕ) (L₁ : Type) [Field L₁] [NumberField L₁] [Algebra L L₁] [Algebra L₁ Ω]
    [IsScalarTower L L₁ Ω] [IsCyclotomicExtension {l ^ n} L L₁] :
    galOf L L₁ Ω = layU l L Ω (n - cZero l L) ∧ Module.finrank L L₁ = l ^ (n - cZero l L) := by
  haveI : IsAlgClosure L₁ Ω := ⟨IsAlgClosure.isAlgClosed L, Algebra.IsAlgebraic.tower_top (K := L) L₁⟩
  have h1 : galOf L L₁ Ω = Un L Ω l n := by
    rw [galOfCyc L Ω l n L L₁, galOf_self]
  have h2 : Un L Ω l n = layU l L Ω (n - cZero l L) := by
    rcases le_total n (cZero l L) with h | h
    · rw [((muQ L Ω l).2.1 n).2 h, layU, ((muQ L Ω l).2.1 _).2 (by omega)]
    · rw [layU, Nat.add_sub_cancel' h]
  refine ⟨h1.trans h2, ?_⟩
  rw [← (galEmbTop L L₁ Ω).2.2, h1, h2, (layerGen L Ω l hmu).1]

theorem UpperTheory.V.Tower.layerUniq :
    ∀ (L Ω : Type) [Field L] [NumberField L] [Field Ω] [Algebra L Ω] [IsAlgClosure L Ω] (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime], HasMuQ l L → (∀ m, IsLayer l m L (layF l L Ω m)) ∧
        (∀ (m : ℕ) (L₁ : Type) [Field L₁] [NumberField L₁] [Algebra L L₁] [Algebra L₁ Ω] [IsScalarTower L L₁ Ω], IsLayer l m L L₁ → galOf L L₁ Ω = layU l L Ω m) ∧
        ∀ (n : ℕ) (L₁ : Type) [Field L₁] [NumberField L₁] [Algebra L L₁], IsCyclotomicExtension {l ^ n} L L₁ → IsLayer l (n - cZero l L) L L₁ := by
  intro L Ω _ _ _ _ _ l hl hmu
  refine ⟨fun m => ?_, fun m L₁ _ _ _ _ _ h => ?_, fun n L₁ _ _ _ h => ?_⟩
  · haveI h := (fnCyc L Ω l (cZero l L + m)).1
    refine ⟨⟨_, h⟩, ?_⟩
    have := (lu_key L Ω l hmu (cZero l L + m) (layF l L Ω m)).2
    rwa [Nat.add_sub_cancel_left] at this
  · obtain ⟨⟨k, hk⟩, hf⟩ := h
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := lu_key L Ω l hmu k L₁
    rw [h1, Nat.pow_right_injective hl.out.two_le (h2.symm.trans hf)]
  · haveI : IsAlgClosed Ω := IsAlgClosure.isAlgClosed L
    haveI : FiniteDimensional L L₁ := Module.Finite.of_restrictScalars_finite ℚ L L₁
    let f : L₁ →ₐ[L] Ω := IsAlgClosed.lift
    letI : Algebra L₁ Ω := f.toRingHom.toAlgebra
    haveI : IsScalarTower L L₁ Ω := IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun x => (f.commutes x).symm
    exact ⟨⟨n, h⟩, (lu_key L Ω l hmu n L₁).2⟩

theorem UpperTheory.V.Tower.layerGen :
    ∀ (L Ω : Type) [Field L] [NumberField L] [Field Ω] [Algebra L Ω] [IsAlgClosure L Ω] (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime], HasMuQ l L → (∀ m, (layU l L Ω m).index = l ^ m) ∧
        ∀ γ : G L Ω, IsGen l ⊤ γ → PropA.IsLevel l (cycZ L Ω l γ : ℤ_[l]ˣ) (cZero l L) ∧ γ ∈ levU l ⊤ 1 ∧ ∀ m, IsGen l (layU l L Ω m) (γ ^ l ^ m) := by
  intro L Ω _ _ _ _ _ l _ hmu
  obtain ⟨-, h2, h3, -⟩ := muQ L Ω l
  have hq := h3.1 hmu
  have hr := cycRange L Ω l hmu
  obtain ⟨p1, p2, p3⟩ := princGen l _ hq
  have h0 : ∀ g, cycZ L Ω l g ∈ KStar.TotallyRealRoots.princ l (cZero l L) := fun g => hr ▸ ⟨g, rfl⟩
  have hU : ∀ n, Un L Ω l n = (KStar.TotallyRealRoots.princ l n).comap (cycZ L Ω l) := fun n =>
    Subgroup.ext fun g => ⟨fun h => h.2, fun h => ⟨trivial, h⟩⟩
  have h1 : 1 ≤ cZero l L := by
    refine le_trans ?_ hq
    unfold qExp
    split_ifs <;> omega
  refine ⟨fun m => ?_, fun γ hγ => ?_⟩
  · rw [layU, hU, Subgroup.index_comap, hr, p3]
  · have hn : cycZ L Ω l γ ∉ KStar.TotallyRealRoots.princ l (cZero l L + 1) := by
      refine (p1 _ (h0 γ)).1 ?_
      rw [← hr, MonoidHom.range_eq_map]
      exact hγ.2
    obtain ⟨q1, q2⟩ := p2 _ (h0 γ) hn
    refine ⟨q1, ?_, fun m => ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
    · have : γ ∈ Un L Ω l 1 := by rw [(h2 1).2 h1]; trivial
      exact this
    · rw [layU, hU, Subgroup.mem_comap, map_pow]
      exact (q2 m).1
    · rw [layU, hU, map_pow]
      exact (Subgroup.map_comap_le _ _).trans
        (((princGen l (cZero l L + m) (hq.trans (Nat.le_add_right _ _))).1 _ (q2 m).1).2 (q2 m).2)

theorem UpperTheory.V.PropA.lteNorm :
    ∀ (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (u : ℤ_[l]) (c : ℕ), IsLevel l u c → ‖u‖ = 1 ∧ (l : ℤ_[l]) ∣ u - 1 ∧
      ∀ j a b : ℕ, ‖(u ^ l ^ j) ^ a - (u ^ l ^ j) ^ b‖ = ((l : ℝ) ^ (j + c))⁻¹ * ‖(a : ℤ_[l]) - b‖ := by
  intro l _ u c hc
  obtain ⟨hv, hc1, hc2⟩ := hc
  have hval1 : IsDiscreteValuationRing.addVal ℤ_[l] (l : ℤ_[l]) = 1 :=
    IsDiscreteValuationRing.addVal_uniformizer PadicInt.irreducible_p
  have hl : (l : ℤ_[l]) ∣ u - 1 := by
    rw [← IsDiscreteValuationRing.addVal_le_iff_dvd, hval1]
    simp only [vl] at hv
    rw [hv]
    exact_mod_cast hc1
  have hn1 : ‖u - 1‖ < 1 := (PadicInt.norm_lt_one_iff_dvd _).2 hl
  have hu : ‖u‖ = 1 := by
    have := PadicInt.norm_eq_of_norm_add_lt_right (z1 := u) (z2 := -1)
      (by rw [norm_neg, norm_one, ← sub_eq_add_neg]; exact hn1)
    rwa [norm_neg, norm_one] at this
  refine ⟨hu, hl, ?_⟩
  intro j a b
  have hunit : IsUnit u := PadicInt.isUnit_iff.2 hu
  set v := hunit.unit with hvdef
  have hvu : (v : ℤ_[l]) = u := hunit.unit_spec
  have hvmem : v ∈ abelian₂.oneUnits ℤ_[l] := by
    show (v : ℤ_[l]) - 1 ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal ℤ_[l]
    rw [IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal, PadicInt.mem_nonunits, hvu]
    exact hn1
  let U : abelian₂.oneUnits ℤ_[l] := ⟨v, hvmem⟩
  set n : ℤ := ((l ^ j * a : ℕ) : ℤ) - ((l ^ j * b : ℕ) : ℤ) with hndef
  have hlm : (l : ℤ_[l]) ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal ℤ_[l] := by
    rw [IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal, PadicInt.mem_nonunits, PadicInt.norm_p]
    exact inv_lt_one_of_one_lt₀ (by exact_mod_cast (Fact.out : l.Prime).one_lt)
  have hptU : IsDiscreteValuationRing.addVal ℤ_[l] ↑(abelian₂.pt U) = c := by
    rw [abelian₂.coe_pt]
    simp only [vl] at hv
    rw [show ((U : ℤ_[l]ˣ) : ℤ_[l]) = u from hvu]
    exact hv
  have hcond : IsDiscreteValuationRing.addVal ℤ_[l] (l : ℤ_[l]) <
      ↑(l - 1) * IsDiscreteValuationRing.addVal ℤ_[l] ↑(abelian₂.pt U) := by
    rw [hval1, hptU]
    have hlt : 1 < (l - 1) * c := by
      have hp := (Fact.out : l.Prime).two_le
      rcases Nat.lt_or_ge l 3 with h | h
      · have h2 : l = 2 := by omega
        have := hc2 h2
        subst h2
        omega
      · have h3 : 2 ≤ l - 1 := by omega
        calc 1 < 2 * 1 := by norm_num
          _ ≤ (l - 1) * c := Nat.mul_le_mul h3 hc1
    exact_mod_cast hlt
  have key := abelian₂.lte ℤ_[l] l Fact.out hlm U hcond n
  have hfac : (u ^ l ^ j) ^ a - (u ^ l ^ j) ^ b = (u ^ l ^ j) ^ b * ↑(abelian₂.pt (U ^ n)) := by
    rw [abelian₂.coe_pt]
    have h1 : ((U ^ n : abelian₂.oneUnits ℤ_[l]) : ℤ_[l]ˣ) = v ^ n := rfl
    have h2 : v ^ ((l ^ j * a : ℕ) : ℤ) = v ^ ((l ^ j * b : ℕ) : ℤ) * v ^ n := by
      rw [← zpow_add]
      congr 1
      rw [hndef]
      ring
    have h3 : ∀ k : ℕ, (u ^ l ^ j) ^ k = ((v ^ ((l ^ j * k : ℕ) : ℤ) : ℤ_[l]ˣ) : ℤ_[l]) := by
      intro k
      rw [zpow_natCast, Units.val_pow_eq_pow_val, hvu, pow_mul]
    rw [h1, h3 a, h3 b, h2, Units.val_mul]
    ring
  rw [hfac, norm_mul, norm_pow, norm_pow, hu, one_pow, one_pow, one_mul]
  rw [norm_eq_of_addVal (y := (l : ℤ_[l]) ^ (j + c) * ((a : ℤ_[l]) - (b : ℤ_[l])))]
  · rw [norm_mul, PadicInt.norm_p_pow, zpow_neg, zpow_natCast]
  · have hcast : ((n : ℤ) : ℤ_[l]) = (l : ℤ_[l]) ^ j * ((a : ℤ_[l]) - (b : ℤ_[l])) := by
      rw [hndef]
      push_cast
      ring
    rw [key, hptU, hcast, IsDiscreteValuationRing.addVal_mul, IsDiscreteValuationRing.addVal_pow,
      IsDiscreteValuationRing.addVal_mul, IsDiscreteValuationRing.addVal_pow, hval1]
    simp only [nsmul_eq_mul, mul_one]
    push_cast
    ring

theorem UpperTheory.V.Tower.princGen :
    ∀ (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (c : ℕ), qExp l ≤ c →
        (∀ u ∈ KStar.TotallyRealRoots.princ l c, (KStar.TotallyRealRoots.princ l c ≤ (Subgroup.zpowers u).topologicalClosure ↔ u ∉ KStar.TotallyRealRoots.princ l (c + 1))) ∧
        (∀ u ∈ KStar.TotallyRealRoots.princ l c, u ∉ KStar.TotallyRealRoots.princ l (c + 1) → PropA.IsLevel l (u : ℤ_[l]) c ∧
          ∀ m : ℕ, u ^ l ^ m ∈ KStar.TotallyRealRoots.princ l (c + m) ∧ u ^ l ^ m ∉ KStar.TotallyRealRoots.princ l (c + m + 1)) ∧
        ∀ m : ℕ, (KStar.TotallyRealRoots.princ l (c + m)).relIndex (KStar.TotallyRealRoots.princ l c) = l ^ m := by
  intro l _ c hc
  have hl : l.Prime := Fact.out
  have h1 : 1 ≤ c := by
    unfold qExp at hc; split_ifs at hc <;> omega
  have h2 : l = 2 → 2 ≤ c := by
    intro h; unfold qExp at hc; simp [h] at hc; omega
  have hexact : ∀ u : ℤ_[l]ˣ, u ∈ KStar.TotallyRealRoots.princ l c → u ∉ KStar.TotallyRealRoots.princ l (c + 1) →
      emultiplicity (l : ℤ_[l]) ((u : ℤ_[l]) - 1) = c := by
    intro u hu hu1
    rw [KStar.TotallyRealRoots.mem_princ] at hu hu1
    exact emultiplicity_eq_coe.mpr ⟨hu, hu1⟩
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro u hu
    constructor
    · intro hle hu1
      have hcl : IsClosed ((KStar.TotallyRealRoots.princ l (c + 1) : Subgroup ℤ_[l]ˣ) : Set ℤ_[l]ˣ) :=
        Subgroup.isClosed_of_isOpen _ (KStar.TotallyRealRoots.isOpen_princ _)
      have hcle := Subgroup.topologicalClosure_minimal _ (Subgroup.zpowers_le.mpr hu1) hcl
      obtain ⟨v, hv, hv'⟩ := pg_exists (l := l) h1
      exact hv' (hcle (hle hv))
    · intro hu1
      exact KStar.TotallyRealRoots.princ_le_of_isClosed h1 h2 (Subgroup.isClosed_topologicalClosure _)
        (Subgroup.le_topologicalClosure _ (Subgroup.mem_zpowers u)) (hexact u hu hu1)
  · intro u hu hu1
    have he := hexact u hu hu1

theorem UpperTheory.V.PropA.cokL :
    ∀ (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (X : Type) [AddCommGroup X] [Module ℤ_[l] X] (R : ℕ), GenBy l R X → cokLen ((l : ℤ_[l]) • (1 : Module.End ℤ_[l] X)) ≤ R := by
  intro l _ X _ _ R hgen
  obtain ⟨π, hπ⟩ := hgen
  classical
  let I : Submodule ℤ_[l] ℤ_[l] := IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal ℤ_[l]
  have hsimple : IsSimpleModule ℤ_[l] (ℤ_[l] ⧸ I) :=
    isSimpleModule_iff_isCoatom.2 (Ideal.isMaximal_def.1 (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal.isMaximal ℤ_[l]))
  let P : Submodule ℤ_[l] (Fin R → ℤ_[l]) := Submodule.pi Set.univ (fun _ => I)
  let q : Submodule ℤ_[l] X := LinearMap.range ((l : ℤ_[l]) • (1 : Module.End ℤ_[l] X))
  have hle : P ≤ q.comap π := by
    intro v hv
    rw [Submodule.mem_pi] at hv
    have hex : ∀ i, ∃ w : ℤ_[l], v i = (l : ℤ_[l]) * w := by
      intro i
      have hi := hv i (Set.mem_univ i)
      change v i ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal ℤ_[l] at hi
      rw [PadicInt.maximalIdeal_eq_span_p, Ideal.mem_span_singleton'] at hi
      obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hi
      exact ⟨a, by rw [← ha, mul_comm]⟩
    choose w hw using hex
    have hv' : v = (l : ℤ_[l]) • w := funext fun i => by simp [hw i]
    rw [Submodule.mem_comap, LinearMap.mem_range]
    refine ⟨π w, ?_⟩
    rw [LinearMap.smul_apply, Module.End.one_apply, hv', map_smul]
  have hφ : Function.Surjective (P.mapQ q π hle) := by
    intro z
    refine Submodule.Quotient.induction_on _ z ?_
    intro x
    obtain ⟨v, rfl⟩ := hπ x
    exact ⟨Submodule.Quotient.mk v, Submodule.mapQ_apply _ _ _ _⟩
  have h1 := Module.length_le_of_surjective (P.mapQ q π hle) hφ
  have h2 : Module.length ℤ_[l] ((Fin R → ℤ_[l]) ⧸ P) = R := by
    rw [(Submodule.quotientPi (fun _ : Fin R => I)).length_eq, Module.length_pi_of_fintype]
    simp [Module.length_eq_one]
  exact h1.trans h2.le

theorem UpperTheory.V.PropA.nilLen :
    ∀ (A M : Type) [CommRing A] [AddCommGroup M] [Module A M] (f : Module.End A M) (n : ℕ), IsNilpotent f →
      Module.length A M ≤ n → f ^ n = 0 := by
  intro A M _ _ _ f n hf hlen
  by_contra hne
  have hm : ∀ m, m ≤ n → f ^ m ≠ 0 := fun m hm h0 => hne (pow_eq_zero_of_le hm h0)
  have key : ∀ j m, m + j = n → (j : ℕ∞) + 1 ≤ Order.height (LinearMap.range (f ^ m)) := by
    intro j
    induction j with
    | zero =>
      intro m hmj
      have hlt : (⊥ : Submodule A M) < LinearMap.range (f ^ m) := by
        rw [bot_lt_iff_ne_bot, Ne, LinearMap.range_eq_bot]
        exact hm m (by omega)
      have h0 := Order.height_add_one_le hlt
      simp only [Nat.cast_zero, zero_add]
      exact le_trans le_add_self h0
    | succ j ih =>
      intro m hmj
      have h1 := ih (m + 1) (by omega)
      have h2 := Order.height_add_one_le (nilLen_lt f hf m (hm m (by omega)))
      calc ((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) + 1 = ((j : ℕ∞) + 1) + 1 := by push_cast; rfl
        _ ≤ Order.height (LinearMap.range (f ^ (m + 1))) + 1 := by gcongr
        _ ≤ _ := h2
  have h3 := key n 0 (by omega)
  rw [Module.length_eq_height] at hlen
  have h4 : Order.height (LinearMap.range (f ^ 0)) ≤ Order.height (⊤ : Submodule A M) :=
    Order.height_mono le_top
  have h5 : ((n : ℕ) : ℕ∞) + 1 ≤ (n : ℕ∞) := h3.trans (h4.trans hlen)
  norm_cast at h5
  omega

private theorem nilLen_lt {A M : Type} [CommRing A] [AddCommGroup M] [Module A M]
    (f : Module.End A M) (hf : IsNilpotent f) (k : ℕ) (hk : f ^ k ≠ 0) :
    LinearMap.range (f ^ (k + 1)) < LinearMap.range (f ^ k) := by
  refine lt_of_le_of_ne ?_ ?_
  · rw [pow_succ, Module.End.mul_eq_comp]
    exact LinearMap.range_comp_le_range _ _
  · intro h
    apply hk
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hf
    have key : ∀ j, LinearMap.range (f ^ (k + j)) = LinearMap.range (f ^ k) := by
      intro j
      induction j with
      | zero => simp
      | succ j ih => rw [← add_assoc, nilLen_range_succ, ih, ← nilLen_range_succ, h]
    have hkn := key n
    rw [pow_add, hn, mul_zero, LinearMap.range_zero] at hkn
    exact LinearMap.range_eq_bot.mp hkn.symm

theorem UpperTheory.V.PropA.phi :
    ∀ (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (X : Type) [AddCommGroup X] [Module ℤ_[l] X] [Module.Finite ℤ_[l] X] (w : Module.End ℤ_[l] X), InPow 2 (w - 1) →
      LinearMap.range ((l : ℤ_[l]) • (1 : Module.End ℤ_[l] X)) ≤ LinearMap.range (∑ i ∈ Finset.range l, w ^ i) := by
  intro l _ X _ _ _ w hw
  have hpow : ∀ (i : ℕ) (x : X), ∃ y : X, (w ^ i) x = x + (l : ℤ_[l]) ^ 2 • y := by
    intro i
    induction i with
    | zero => intro x; exact ⟨0, by simp⟩
    | succ i ih =>
      intro x
      obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := ih (w x)
      obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := hw x
      refine ⟨z + y, ?_⟩
      rw [pow_succ, Module.End.mul_apply, hy, smul_add, ← hz]
      simp only [LinearMap.sub_apply, Module.End.one_apply]
      abel
  have hsum : ∀ (n : ℕ) (x : X), ∃ y : X,
      (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, w ^ i) x = (n : ℤ_[l]) • x + (l : ℤ_[l]) ^ 2 • y := by
    intro n x
    induction n with
    | zero => exact ⟨0, by simp⟩
    | succ n ih =>
      obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := ih
      obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := hpow n x
      refine ⟨y + z, ?_⟩
      rw [Finset.sum_range_succ, LinearMap.add_apply, hy, hz, smul_add, Nat.cast_succ, add_smul, one_smul]
      abel
  refine Submodule.le_of_le_smul_of_le_jacobson_bot (I := Ideal.span {(l : ℤ_[l])}) ?_ ?_ ?_
  · exact IsNoetherian.noetherian _
  · rw [IsLocalRing.jacobson_eq_maximalIdeal _ bot_ne_top, PadicInt.maximalIdeal_eq_span_p]
  · rintro _ ⟨x, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := hsum l x
    have e : ((l : ℤ_[l]) • (1 : Module.End ℤ_[l] X)) x
        = (∑ i ∈ Finset.range l, w ^ i) x + (l : ℤ_[l]) • (((l : ℤ_[l]) • (1 : Module.End ℤ_[l] X)) (-y)) := by
      rw [hy]
      simp only [LinearMap.smul_apply, Module.End.one_apply, smul_neg, pow_two, mul_smul]
      abel
    rw [e]
    exact Submodule.add_mem_sup (LinearMap.mem_range_self _ _)
      (Submodule.smul_mem_smul (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self _) (LinearMap.mem_range_self _ _))

theorem UpperTheory.V.PropA.step :
    ∀ (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (X : Type) [AddCommGroup X] [Module ℤ_[l] X] (R : ℕ) (w : Module.End ℤ_[l] X), GenBy l R X → InPow 2 (w - 1) →
      cokLen (w ^ l - 1) ≤ cokLen (w - 1) + R := by
  intro l _ X _ _ R w hG hw
  haveI : Module.Finite ℤ_[l] X := by
    obtain ⟨π, hπ⟩ := hG
    exact Module.Finite.of_surjective π hπ
  have h1 := (UpperTheory.V.Base.lenComp ℤ_[l] X (∑ i ∈ Finset.range l, w ^ i) (w - 1)).2
  rw [geom_sum_mul] at h1
  have h2 := cokLen_le_of_range_le (phi l X w hw)
  have h3 := cokL l X R hG
  calc cokLen (w ^ l - 1) ≤ cokLen (∑ i ∈ Finset.range l, w ^ i) + cokLen (w - 1) := h1
    _ ≤ R + cokLen (w - 1) := add_le_add_left (h2.trans h3) _
    _ = cokLen (w - 1) + R := add_comm _ _

theorem UpperTheory.V.PropA.unipPow :
    ∀ (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (X : Type) [AddCommGroup X] [Module ℤ_[l] X] (R : ℕ) (g : Module.End ℤ_[l] X), GenBy l R X → Unip g → InPow 1 ((g - 1) ^ R) := by
  intro l _ X _ _ R g hgen hu
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := hu
  let p : Submodule ℤ_[l] X := LinearMap.range ((l : ℤ_[l]) • (1 : Module.End ℤ_[l] X))
  have memp : ∀ v : X, v ∈ p ↔ ∃ y, v = (l : ℤ_[l]) ^ 1 • y := by
    intro v
    simp only [p, LinearMap.mem_range, LinearMap.smul_apply, Module.End.one_apply, pow_one]
    exact ⟨fun ⟨y, hy⟩ => ⟨y, hy.symm⟩, fun ⟨y, hy⟩ => ⟨y, hy.symm⟩⟩
  have hp : p ≤ p.comap (g - 1) := by
    intro v hv
    obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := (memp v).mp hv
    rw [Submodule.mem_comap, map_smul]
    exact (memp _).mpr ⟨(g - 1) y, rfl⟩
  let F : Module.End ℤ_[l] (X ⧸ p) := p.mapQ p (g - 1) hp
  have hFx : ∀ x : X, F (Submodule.Quotient.mk x) = Submodule.Quotient.mk ((g - 1) x) :=
    fun x => Submodule.mapQ_apply _ _ _ x
  have key : ∀ (k : ℕ) (x : X), (F ^ k) (Submodule.Quotient.mk x) = Submodule.Quotient.mk (((g - 1) ^ k) x) := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero =>
      intro x
      simp
    | succ k ih =>
      intro x
      rw [pow_succ, Module.End.mul_apply, hFx, ih, pow_succ, Module.End.mul_apply]
  have hnil : IsNilpotent F := by
    refine ⟨N, ?_⟩
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro z
    obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mkQ_surjective p z
    rw [Submodule.mkQ_apply, key, LinearMap.zero_apply, Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero, memp]
    exact hN x
  have hlen : Module.length ℤ_[l] (X ⧸ p) ≤ R := cokL l X R hgen
  have hF0 := nilLen ℤ_[l] (X ⧸ p) F R hnil hlen
  intro x
  have hk := key R x
  rw [hF0, LinearMap.zero_apply, eq_comm, Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero, memp] at hk
  exact hk

theorem UpperTheory.V.PropA.twist :
    ∀ (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (X : Type) [AddCommGroup X] [Module ℤ_[l] X] (g : Module.End ℤ_[l] X) (a : ℤ_[l]), (l : ℤ_[l]) ∣ a - 1 →
      Unip g → Unip (a • g) := by
  intro l _ X _ _ g a ha hg
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := hg
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := ha
  have left : ∀ f h : Module.End ℤ_[l] X, InPow 1 f → InPow 1 (h * f) := by
    intro f h hf v
    obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := hf v
    exact ⟨h w, by rw [Module.End.mul_apply, hw, map_smul]⟩
  have right : ∀ f h : Module.End ℤ_[l] X, InPow 1 f → InPow 1 (f * h) := by
    intro f h hf v
    exact hf (h v)
  have zero : InPow 1 (0 : Module.End ℤ_[l] X) := fun v => ⟨0, by simp⟩
  have add : ∀ f h : Module.End ℤ_[l] X, InPow 1 f → InPow 1 h → InPow 1 (f + h) := by
    intro f h hf hh v
    obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := hf v
    obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := hh v
    exact ⟨w + u, by rw [LinearMap.add_apply, hw, hu, smul_add]⟩
  have hB : InPow 1 ((a - 1) • g) := by
    intro v
    refine ⟨c • g v, ?_⟩
    rw [LinearMap.smul_apply, hc, mul_smul, pow_one]
  have hcomm : Commute (g - 1) ((a - 1) • g) :=
    ((Commute.refl g).sub_left (Commute.one_left g)).smul_right (a - 1)
  have hsplit : a • g - 1 = (g - 1) + (a - 1) • g := by
    rw [sub_smul, one_smul]
    abel
  refine ⟨N, ?_⟩
  rw [hsplit, hcomm.add_pow]
  refine Finset.sum_induction _ (InPow 1) add zero ?_
  intro m hm
  rcases Nat.lt_or_ge m N with hlt | hge
  · obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ : ∃ k, N - m = k + 1 := ⟨N - m - 1, by omega⟩
    rw [hk, pow_succ']
    apply right
    rw [← mul_assoc]
    apply right
    exact left _ _ hB
  · have hmN : m = N := by
      simp only [Finset.mem_range] at hm
      omega
    subst hmN
    exact right _ _ (right _ _ hN)

private theorem padic_units_distance_le_max (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (a b : ℤ_[l]) (ha : ‖a‖ = 1) (hb : ‖b‖ = 1)
    (z : PadicAlgCl l) :
    ‖a - b‖ ≤ max ‖algebraMap ℚ_[l] (PadicAlgCl l) (a : ℚ_[l]) * z - 1‖
      ‖algebraMap ℚ_[l] (PadicAlgCl l) (b : ℚ_[l]) * z - 1‖ := by
  set A := algebraMap ℚ_[l] (PadicAlgCl l) (a : ℚ_[l])
  set B := algebraMap ℚ_[l] (PadicAlgCl l) (b : ℚ_[l])
  have hA : ‖A‖ = 1 := by
    simp only [A, PadicAlgCl.norm_extends, ← PadicInt.norm_def, ha]
  have hAB : ‖A - B‖ = ‖a - b‖ := by
    simp only [A, B, ← map_sub, PadicAlgCl.norm_extends, ← PadicInt.coe_sub, ← PadicInt.norm_def]
  have hdiff : A * z - 1 - (B * z - 1) = (A - B) * z := by ring
  have hmax : ‖A * z - 1 - (B * z - 1)‖ ≤ max ‖A * z - 1‖ ‖B * z - 1‖ := by
    have := IsUltrametricDist.norm_add_le_max (A * z - 1) (-(B * z - 1))
    rwa [norm_neg, ← sub_eq_add_neg] at this
  rcases le_or_gt 1 ‖z‖ with hz | hz
  · calc ‖a - b‖ ≤ ‖a - b‖ * ‖z‖ := le_mul_of_one_le_right (norm_nonneg _) hz
      _ = ‖A * z - 1 - (B * z - 1)‖ := by rw [hdiff, norm_mul, hAB]
      _ ≤ _ := hmax
  · have hAz : ‖A * z‖ < 1 := by rw [norm_mul, hA, one_mul]; exact hz
    have h1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ ‖A * z - 1‖ := by
      have := IsUltrametricDist.norm_add_le_max (A * z) (-(A * z - 1))
      rw [norm_neg, show A * z + -(A * z - 1) = 1 by ring, norm_one] at this
      rcases le_max_iff.mp this with h | h
      · exact absurd h (not_le.mpr hAz)
      · exact h
    calc ‖a - b‖ ≤ 1 := PadicInt.norm_le_one _
      _ ≤ ‖A * z - 1‖ := h1
      _ ≤ _ := le_max_left _ _

theorem UpperTheory.V.PropA.normVal :
    ∀ (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (R c : ℕ) (d : ℤ_[l]) (x : Fin R → ℤ_[l]),
      ∏ i, (((l : ℝ) ^ c)⁻¹ * ‖x i‖) ≤ ‖d‖ → vl l d ≤ ∑ i, ((c : ℕ∞) + vl l (x i)) := by
  intro l _ R c d x h
  have h1 : ‖∏ i, ((l : ℤ_[l]) ^ c * x i)‖ = ∏ i, (((l : ℝ) ^ c)⁻¹ * ‖x i‖) := by
    rw [norm_prod]
    refine Finset.prod_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
    rw [norm_mul, norm_pow, PadicInt.norm_p, inv_pow]
  have h2 : d ∣ ∏ i, ((l : ℤ_[l]) ^ c * x i) := dvd_of_norm_le' (h1 ▸ h)
  have h3 : vl l (∏ i, ((l : ℤ_[l]) ^ c * x i)) = ∑ i, ((c : ℕ∞) + vl l (x i)) := by
    rw [vl_prod]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
    have := (PadicInt.irreducible_p (p := l)).addVal_pow c
    unfold vl
    rw [IsDiscreteValuationRing.addVal_mul, this]
  rw [← h3]
  exact IsDiscreteValuationRing.addVal_le_iff_dvd.mpr h2

theorem UpperTheory.V.PropA.detBound :
    ∀ (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (u : ℤ_[l]) (c : ℕ), IsLevel l u c → ∀ (j R : ℕ) (S : Matrix (Fin R) (Fin R) ℤ_[l]),
      ∃ s : Fin R → ℤ_[l], ∀ e : ℕ, vl l ((u ^ l ^ j) ^ e • S - 1).det ≤ ∑ i, (((j + c : ℕ) : ℕ∞) + vl l (s i - e)) := by
  intro l _ u c hc j R S
  let φ : ℤ_[l] →+* PadicAlgCl l := (algebraMap ℚ_[l] (PadicAlgCl l)).comp PadicInt.Coe.ringHom
  have hφ : ∀ x, ‖φ x‖ = ‖x‖ := by
    intro x
    show ‖algebraMap ℚ_[l] (PadicAlgCl l) (x : ℚ_[l])‖ = ‖x‖
    rw [← PadicInt.padic_norm_e_of_padicInt]
    exact PadicAlgCl.norm_extends l (x : ℚ_[l])
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := detFactor (PadicAlgCl l) R (S.map φ)
  choose s hs using fun i => ball l u c hc j (z i)
  refine ⟨s, fun e => ?_⟩
  apply normVal l R (j + c) _ (fun i => s i - e)
  set a : ℤ_[l] := (u ^ l ^ j) ^ e with ha
  have hdet : φ (a • S - 1).det = ∏ i, (φ a * z i - 1) := by
    rw [RingHom.map_det, ← hz (φ a)]
    congr 1
    ext p q
    simp [Matrix.sub_apply, Matrix.one_apply, RingHom.mapMatrix_apply]
  rw [← hφ, hdet, norm_prod]
  apply Finset.prod_le_prod
  · intro i _
    positivity
  · intro i _
    exact hs i e

private theorem dvd_of_norm_le' {l : ℕ} [Fact l.Prime] {d y : ℤ_[l]} (h : ‖y‖ ≤ ‖d‖) : d ∣ y := by
  by_cases hy : y = 0
  · subst hy
    exact dvd_zero d
  by_cases hd : d = 0
  · subst hd
    rw [norm_zero, norm_le_zero_iff] at h
    exact absurd h hy
  have hav : ∀ x : ℤ_[l], x ≠ 0 → IsDiscreteValuationRing.addVal ℤ_[l] x = x.valuation :=
    fun x hx => IsDiscreteValuationRing.addVal_def x (PadicInt.unitCoeff hx) PadicInt.irreducible_p _
      (PadicInt.unitCoeff_spec hx)
  rw [← IsDiscreteValuationRing.addVal_le_iff_dvd, hav d hd, hav y hy, Nat.cast_le]
  rw [PadicInt.norm_eq_zpow_neg_valuation hd, PadicInt.norm_le_pow_iff_le_valuation y hy] at h
  exact h

private theorem vl_prod {l : ℕ} [Fact l.Prime] {ι : Type} (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → ℤ_[l]) :

theorem UpperTheory.V.PropA.qzInj :
    ∀ (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime], Module.Injective ℤ_[l] (QZ l) := by
  intro l _
  refine Module.Baer.injective ?_
  intro I g
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := (IsPrincipalIdealRing.principal I).principal
  have hmem : ∀ x ∈ I, ∃ c : ℤ_[l], c • a = x := fun x hx =>
    Submodule.mem_span_singleton.1 (ha ▸ hx)
  have haI : a ∈ I := ha ▸ Submodule.mem_span_singleton_self a
  have hy : ∃ y : QZ l, a • y = g ⟨a, haI⟩ := by
    by_cases h0 : a = 0
    · refine ⟨0, ?_⟩
      have : (⟨a, haI⟩ : I) = 0 := Subtype.ext h0
      rw [this, map_zero, smul_zero]
    · exact (UpperTheory.V.Kum.qzBasic l).1 a h0 _
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := hy
  refine ⟨LinearMap.toSpanSingleton ℤ_[l] (QZ l) y, fun x hx => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := hmem x hx
  have : (⟨c • a, hx⟩ : I) = c • (⟨a, haI⟩ : I) := rfl
  rw [this, map_smul g, ← hy, LinearMap.toSpanSingleton_apply, smul_eq_mul, mul_smul]

theorem UpperTheory.V.PropA.dualDiv :
    ∀ (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (D : Type) [AddCommGroup D] [Module ℤ_[l] D] (x : D →ₗ[ℤ_[l]] QZ l), (∀ φ : D, (l : ℤ_[l]) • φ = 0 → x φ = 0) →
      ∃ y : D →ₗ[ℤ_[l]] QZ l, x = (l : ℤ_[l]) • y := by
  intro l _ D _ _ x hx
  let μ : D →ₗ[ℤ_[l]] D := (l : ℤ_[l]) • LinearMap.id
  have hker : LinearMap.ker μ ≤ LinearMap.ker x := by
    intro φ hφ
    exact hx φ (by simpa [μ] using hφ)
  let g : LinearMap.range μ →ₗ[ℤ_[l]] QZ l :=
    ((LinearMap.ker μ).liftQ x hker).comp (LinearMap.quotKerEquivRange μ).symm.toLinearMap
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := (qzInj l).out (LinearMap.range μ).subtype Subtype.val_injective g
  refine ⟨y, ?_⟩
  ext φ
  have hmem : μ φ ∈ LinearMap.range μ := LinearMap.mem_range_self μ φ
  have h1 := hy ⟨μ φ, hmem⟩
  have h3 : (LinearMap.quotKerEquivRange μ).symm ⟨μ φ, hmem⟩ = Submodule.Quotient.mk φ := by
    rw [LinearEquiv.symm_apply_eq]
    rfl
  have h2 : g ⟨μ φ, hmem⟩ = x φ := by
    simp only [g, LinearMap.coe_comp, LinearEquiv.coe_coe, Function.comp_apply]
    rw [h3, Submodule.liftQ_apply]
  rw [h2] at h1
  simp only [Submodule.coe_subtype, μ, LinearMap.smul_apply, LinearMap.id_apply] at h1
  rw [LinearMap.smul_apply, ← h1, map_smul]

theorem UpperTheory.V.PropA.torsFin :
    ∀ (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (D : Type) [AddCommGroup D] [Module ℤ_[l] D], Module.Finite ℤ_[l] (D →ₗ[ℤ_[l]] QZ l) →
      {φ : D | (l : ℤ_[l]) • φ = 0}.Finite := by
  intro l _ D _ _ hfin
  have hl : l.Prime := Fact.out
  obtain ⟨ι, hιinj, hιrange, -⟩ := UpperTheory.V.Kum.zmodToQZ l 1
  haveI : NeZero (l ^ 1) := ⟨pow_ne_zero _ hl.ne_zero⟩
  haveI : Fact (1 < l ^ 1) := ⟨by rw [pow_one]; exact hl.one_lt⟩
  set Q : Set (QZ l) := {q | (l : ℤ_[l]) • q = 0} with hQ
  have hQfin : Q.Finite := by
    have : Q = Set.range ι := by
      ext q
      rw [hιrange q, pow_one]
      rfl
    rw [this]
    exact Set.finite_range ι
  have hι1 : ι 1 ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    have h0 : ι 1 = ι 0 := by rw [h, map_zero]
    have := hιinj h0
    exact one_ne_zero this
  have hlι : (l : ℤ_[l]) • ι 1 = 0 := by
    have := (hιrange (ι 1)).mp ⟨1, rfl⟩
    simpa using this
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := hfin.fg_top
  have hsep : ∀ t : D, (l : ℤ_[l]) • t = 0 → (∀ g ∈ s, g t = 0) → t = 0 := by
    intro t htl hg
    have hall : LinearMap.applyₗ (R := ℤ_[l]) (M₂ := QZ l) t = 0 :=
      LinearMap.ext_on hs (fun g hg' => by simpa using hg g hg')
    by_contra ht
    let μt : ℤ_[l] →ₗ[ℤ_[l]] D := LinearMap.toSpanSingleton ℤ_[l] D t
    let ν : ℤ_[l] →ₗ[ℤ_[l]] QZ l := LinearMap.toSpanSingleton ℤ_[l] (QZ l) (ι 1)
    have hker : LinearMap.ker μt ≤ LinearMap.ker ν := by
      intro a ha
      have ha' : a • t = 0 := by simpa [μt] using ha
      show a • ι 1 = 0
      by_cases hu : IsUnit a
      · exact absurd ((hu.smul_eq_zero).mp ha') ht
      · have hm : a ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal ℤ_[l] := (IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal a).mpr hu
        rw [PadicInt.maximalIdeal_eq_span_p, Ideal.mem_span_singleton'] at hm
        obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := hm
        rw [mul_smul, hlι, smul_zero]
    let g0 : LinearMap.range μt →ₗ[ℤ_[l]] QZ l :=
      ((LinearMap.ker μt).liftQ ν hker).comp (LinearMap.quotKerEquivRange μt).symm.toLinearMap
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := (qzInj l).out (LinearMap.range μt).subtype Subtype.val_injective g0
    have hmem : μt 1 ∈ LinearMap.range μt := LinearMap.mem_range_self μt 1
    have h3 : (LinearMap.quotKerEquivRange μt).symm ⟨μt 1, hmem⟩ = Submodule.Quotient.mk 1 := by
      rw [LinearEquiv.symm_apply_eq]
      rfl
    have h1 := hy ⟨μt 1, hmem⟩
    have h2 : g0 ⟨μt 1, hmem⟩ = ι 1 := by
      simp only [g0, LinearMap.coe_comp, LinearEquiv.coe_coe, Function.comp_apply]
      rw [h3, Submodule.liftQ_apply]
      simp [ν]
    rw [h2] at h1
    have hyt : y t = 0 := by
      have := LinearMap.congr_fun hall y
      simpa using this
    have : μt 1 = t := by simp [μt]
    simp only [Submodule.coe_subtype, this] at h1
    exact hι1 (h1 ▸ hyt)
  let f : D → (s → QZ l) := fun φ g => (g : D →ₗ[ℤ_[l]] QZ l) φ
  have hpi : (Set.pi Set.univ (fun _ : s => Q)).Finite := Set.Finite.pi (fun _ => hQfin)
  apply Set.Finite.of_finite_image (f := f) _ _
  · apply hpi.subset
    rintro _ ⟨φ, hφ, rfl⟩ g _
    show (l : ℤ_[l]) • (g : D →ₗ[ℤ_[l]] QZ l) φ = 0
    rw [← map_smul, show (l : ℤ_[l]) • φ = 0 from hφ, map_zero]
  · intro φ hφ ψ hψ hfe
    have hφ' : (l : ℤ_[l]) • φ = 0 := hφ
    have hψ' : (l : ℤ_[l]) • ψ = 0 := hψ
    have := hsep (φ - ψ) (by rw [smul_sub, hφ', hψ', sub_zero]) (fun g hg => by
      have := congr_fun hfe ⟨g, hg⟩
      simp only [f] at this
      rw [map_sub, this, sub_self])
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp this

theorem UpperTheory.V.PropA.dualUnip :
    ∀ (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (D : Type) [AddCommGroup D] [Module ℤ_[l] D] (g : Module.End ℤ_[l] D) (t : Module.End ℤ_[l] (D →ₗ[ℤ_[l]] QZ l)),
      Module.Finite ℤ_[l] (D →ₗ[ℤ_[l]] QZ l) → (∀ x φ, t x φ = x (g φ)) → (∀ φ : D, ∃ k : ℕ, ((g - 1) ^ k) φ = 0) → Unip t := by
  intro l _ D _ _ g t hfin ht hnil
  classical
  have hT := torsFin l D hfin
  choose k hk using hnil
  have key : ∀ (n : ℕ) (x : D →ₗ[ℤ_[l]] QZ l) (φ : D), ((t - 1) ^ n) x φ = x (((g - 1) ^ n) φ) := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero =>
      intro x φ
      simp
    | succ n ih =>
      intro x φ
      rw [pow_succ, Module.End.mul_apply, ih]
      rw [pow_succ' (g - 1), Module.End.mul_apply]
      simp [ht, map_sub]
  refine ⟨hT.toFinset.sup k, fun x => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := dualDiv l D (((t - 1) ^ (hT.toFinset.sup k)) x) (by
    intro φ hφ
    rw [key]
    have hmem : φ ∈ hT.toFinset := by simpa using hφ
    have hle : k φ ≤ hT.toFinset.sup k := Finset.le_sup hmem
    rw [← Nat.sub_add_cancel hle, pow_add, Module.End.mul_apply, hk, map_zero, map_zero])
  exact ⟨y, by simpa using hy⟩

theorem UpperTheory.V.PropA.growth :
    ∀ (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (X : Type) [AddCommGroup X] [Module ℤ_[l] X] (R : ℕ) (g : Module.End ℤ_[l] X), GenBy l R X → Unip g → ∀ m : ℕ,
      cokLen (g ^ l ^ m - 1) ≤ cokLen (g ^ l ^ jZero l R - 1) + ((R * (m - jZero l R) : ℕ) : ℕ∞) := by
  intro l _ X _ _ R g hG hU m
  have hl : 1 < l := (Fact.out : l.Prime).one_lt
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ : ∃ k, k = Nat.log l R + 1 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hRk : R ≤ l ^ k := by
    rw [hk]
    exact (Nat.lt_pow_succ_log_self hl R).le
  have hA : InPow 1 ((g - 1) ^ l ^ k) := by
    have h0 := unipPow l X R g hG hU
    have hsplit : (g - 1) ^ l ^ k = (g - 1) ^ (l ^ k - R) * (g - 1) ^ R := by
      rw [← pow_add, Nat.sub_add_cancel hRk]
    intro x
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := h0 x
    refine ⟨((g - 1) ^ (l ^ k - R)) y, ?_⟩
    rw [hsplit, Module.End.mul_apply, hy, map_smul]
  have hB : InPow 2 (g ^ l ^ (k + 1) - 1) := by
    have h := (powIn l X (g ^ l ^ k)).2 ((frob l X g k).1 hA)
    rwa [← pow_mul, ← pow_succ] at h
  have hC : ∀ n, k + 1 ≤ n → InPow 2 (g ^ l ^ n - 1) := by
    intro n hn

theorem UpperTheory.V.PropA.lift :
    ∀ (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (X : Type) [AddCommGroup X] [Module ℤ_[l] X] (R : ℕ) (g : Module.End ℤ_[l] X), GenBy l R X →
      ∃ S : Matrix (Fin R) (Fin R) ℤ_[l], ∀ c : ℤ_[l], cokLen (c • g - 1) ≤ vl l (c • S - 1).det := by
  intro l _ X _ _ R g hgen
  obtain ⟨π, hπ⟩ := hgen
  choose s hs using fun j : Fin R => hπ (g (π (Pi.single j 1)))
  refine ⟨Matrix.of fun i j => s j i, fun c => ?_⟩
  have hcomm : ∀ v : Fin R → ℤ_[l], π (Matrix.mulVec (Matrix.of fun i j => s j i) v) = g (π v) := by
    have h : π ∘ₗ (Matrix.of fun i j => s j i).mulVecLin = g ∘ₗ π := by
      ext j
      simp [Matrix.mulVec_single_one]
      rw [← hs j]
      rfl
    intro v
    simpa using LinearMap.congr_fun h v
  set A : Matrix (Fin R) (Fin R) ℤ_[l] := c • (Matrix.of fun i j => s j i) - 1 with hA
  have hcommA : ∀ v, π (A.mulVecLin v) = (c • g - 1) (π v) := by
    intro v
    simp only [hA, Matrix.mulVecLin_apply, Matrix.sub_mulVec, Matrix.smul_mulVec,
      Matrix.one_mulVec, map_sub, map_smul, hcomm, LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply,
      Module.End.one_apply]
  let φ : (Fin R → ℤ_[l]) →ₗ[ℤ_[l]] X ⧸ LinearMap.range (c • g - 1) :=
    (LinearMap.range (c • g - 1)).mkQ ∘ₗ π
  have hker : LinearMap.range A.mulVecLin ≤ LinearMap.ker φ := by
    rintro _ ⟨v, rfl⟩
    simp only [LinearMap.mem_ker, φ, LinearMap.comp_apply, Submodule.mkQ_apply,
      Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero]
    rw [hcommA]
    exact LinearMap.mem_range_self _ _
  have hsurj : Function.Surjective ((LinearMap.range A.mulVecLin).liftQ φ hker) := by
    intro x
    obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mkQ_surjective _ x
    obtain ⟨v, rfl⟩ := hπ y
    exact ⟨Submodule.Quotient.mk v, rfl⟩
  have hlen := Module.length_le_of_surjective _ hsurj
  have hdet := KStar.Selmer.length_cokernel_eq_addVal_det A
  unfold cokLen
  exact hlen.trans_eq hdet

theorem exists_centres {R c : ℕ} {γ : Module.End ℤ_[l] X} {u : ℤ_[l]} (hX : GenBy l R X) (hγ : Unip γ) (hu : IsLevel l u c) :
    ∃ s : Fin R → ℤ_[l], ∀ e m : ℕ,
      twLen γ u e m ≤ ∑ i, (((max m (jZero l R) + c : ℕ) : ℕ∞) + vl l (s i - e)) := by
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := exists_centres_level γ hX hu (jZero l R)
  refine ⟨s, fun e m => ?_⟩
  refine (twLen_le_growth hX hγ hu e m).trans ?_
  have hm : max m (jZero l R) + c = (jZero l R + c) + (m - jZero l R) := by omega
  have key : ∑ i, (((max m (jZero l R) + c : ℕ) : ℕ∞) + vl l (s i - e))
      = ∑ i, (((jZero l R + c : ℕ) : ℕ∞) + vl l (s i - e)) + ((R * (m - jZero l R) : ℕ) : ℕ∞) := by
    rw [hm]
    simp only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_mul, Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ,
      Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul]
    ring
  rw [key]
  gcongr
  exact hs e

    (hc : ∃ ζ : L₀, IsPrimitiveRoot ζ (l ^ c)) (h : Descends l L₀ γ) : Win.ABound l R L₀ := by
  have hX : GenBy l R (XP l L₀) := ht.gen
  have hγ := xUnip L₀ (AlgebraicClosure L₀) l l ⊤ isClosed_univ ht.gen.finite γ (mem_levU_one (lteNorm l _ c hu).2.1)
  refine ⟨?_, fun e he m L₁ _ _ _ h₁ L₂ _ _ _ h₂ Ω _ _ _ D => ?_⟩

    refine ⟨ℚ_[l], inferInstance, inferInstance, inferInstance, c, R, fun i => s i, le_rfl, hc,

    refine hs e m B fun i => (hB i).trans (le_of_eq ?_)
    rw [PadicInt.norm_def]
    push_cast

    haveI : IsTotallyComplex L₂ := isTotallyComplex_of_algebra L₀ L₂
    rw [h.eq_twLen he h₁]
    refine (twLen_le_growth hX hγ hu e m).trans (add_le_add ?_ le_rfl)
    rw [← h.eq_twLen he (m := jZero l R) h₂, ← shaLen_eq_shaInv D]
    exact shaLeV hP hF hT L₂ Ω l (ptCase_of_isTotallyComplex L₂ l) D e

io.github.nasqret.proof-atlas.claim: Let ℓ be prime. The tower assumes a totally complex number field L₀, a primitive fourth root in L₀ at ℓ = 2 or a primitive ℓth root at odd ℓ, R ≥ 1, and an ℤℓ-linear surjection ℤℓ^R → X_P. Let c₀ be the maximal ℓ-power root-of-unity depth in L₀. The root hypothesis supplies γ with κ(γ) of exact level c₀ and dense integer powers in the cyclotomic image, as well as a primitive ℓ^c₀-th root in L₀. The root and generator hypotheses give descent. Put j₀ = ⌊log_ℓ R⌋ + 3. The conditional tower estimate gives R integral centres in ℚℓ such that, for every e ≥ 1, the Sha length on any level-m field is at most R(max(m,j₀) + c₀ + B) whenever all centre distances from e are at least ℓ^(−B). On any level-j₀ field, for any algebraic closure and local data D, the assumed global Poitou–Tate duality, local finiteness and local Tate duality bound the reference Sha length by VLen(D,e), the length of H² at twist e + 1. Growth then bounds the level-m Sha length by VLen(D,e) + R max(m − j₀, 0).
